reasons.detail: Atomic approval and task commit — set-step prepares the task-sync intent before writing and passes it with expectedOriginal into one updateStepStatus call; the R1 atomic-boundary test passed.
Failure propagation and concurrency guards — Active-spec failures propagate before mutation and expectedOriginal enforces revision CAS; the R2 failure and drift test passed.
Deterministic idempotent retry — Prepared additions are deterministic and collision-checked; the R3 caller-retry test passed without duplicates.
Retained synchronization contract — Append-only mapping, rounds, promotion, tasksSynced, and the explicit no-active result are retained; the R4 contract test passed.
Specification test coverage — R1-R4 are mapped to the two product files and the spec-local test; execution and result-integrity artifacts both pass and their fingerprints match the fixed commit.
No overengineering — The two-file change reuses StepTransitionCommitIntent and the existing atomic mutation boundary; the dedicated class enforces required invariants without a new framework.
